name: Symbol

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: powdered diamond worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

targets.description: a surface or a closable object; the glyph is up to 10 feet across

summary: A hidden glyph that, when triggered, affects a 60-foot-radius Sphere for 10 minutes with Death, Discord, Fear, Pain, Sleep or Stunning.
text: Spotting the glyph takes a Wisdom (Perception) check against your spell save DC; creatures in the Sphere, entering it or ending a turn there are affected once per turn. Death: Con save, 10d10 Necrotic (half on a success); Discord: Con save or Disadvantage on attacks and checks for 1 minute; Fear: Wis save or Frightened for 1 minute and fleeing 30 feet a turn; Pain: Con save or Incapacitated for 1 minute; Sleep: Wis save or Unconscious for 10 minutes (wakes on damage); Stunning: Wis save or Stunned for 1 minute.
